name: United Kingdom
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Cluedo
inventions.description: Cluedo, known as Clue in North America, is a murder mystery game for three to six players (depending on editions) that was devised in 1943 by British board game designer Anthony E.

inventions.name: difference engine
inventions.description: A difference engine is an automatic mechanical calculator designed to tabulate polynomial functions.

image.author: Benjamin Herschel Babbage, printed in Harper's new monthly magazine

inventions.name: ammonal
inventions.description: Ammonal is an explosive made up of ammonium nitrate and aluminium powder.

inventions.name: Jasperware
inventions.description: Jasperware, or jasper ware, is a type of pottery first developed by Josiah Wedgwood in the 1770s.

image.author: Rebecca Partington from Seattle, Washington, USA

inventions.name: Pedersen bicycle
inventions.description: The Pedersen bicycle, also called the Dursley Pedersen bicycle is a bicycle that was developed by Danish inventor Mikael Pedersen and produced in the English town of Dursley.

inventions.name: Jet engine
inventions.description: A jet engine is a type of reaction engine, discharging a fast-moving jet of heated gas that generates thrust by jet propulsion.

inventions.name: Carbon fiber reinforced polymer
inventions.description: Carbon fiber reinforced polymers are extremely strong and light fiber-reinforced plastics that contain carbon fibers.

inventions.name: Touchpad
inventions.description: A touchpad or trackpad is a type of pointing device.

inventions.name: Flip-flop (electronics)
inventions.description: In electronics, flip-flops and latches are circuits that have two stable states that can store state information – a bistable multivibrator.

inventions.name: Hydraulic accumulator
inventions.description: A hydraulic accumulator is a pressure storage reservoir in which an incompressible hydraulic fluid is held under pressure that is applied by an external source of mechanical energy.

inventions.name: Steam turbine
inventions.description: A steam turbine or steam turbine engine is a machine or heat engine that extracts thermal energy from pressurized steam and uses it to do mechanical work utilising a rotating output shaft.

inventions.name: Acetylcholine
inventions.description: Acetylcholine (ACh) is an organic compound that functions in the brain and body of many types of animals as a neurotransmitter.
